ideas.pitch: A predictive bus arrival and overcrowding forecasting tool built for the Rutgers University Campus bus system using historical GPS data and Poisson regression.
ideas.title: Rutgers Student Transit Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges feel themselves every single day on the Rutgers campus, creating immediate resonance during live judging.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk-scoring and graph intelligence platform to detect anomalies and potential fraud in local New Jersey municipal vendor bidding.
ideas.title: New Jersey Local Government Procurement AML Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets local civic utility and administrative transparency, appealing directly to regional public-sector focused judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered application that coordinates local New Jersey senior citizens with student volunteer drivers for grocery and medical outings.
ideas.title: Scarlet Senior Social Mobility Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features clear measurable social impact with a quantified benefit for local New Jersey communities.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition assistant tailored specifically to the daily menus of Rutgers dining halls to build personalized, healthy meal plans for students.
ideas.title: New Brunswick Dining Hall Nutrition Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student lifestyle pain points at Rutgers, making the demonstration hyper-relevant to the room.

ideas.pitch: Satellite monitoring system utilizing image processing to track environmental compliance and zoning changes in New Jersey industrial zones.
ideas.title: Piscataway Industrial Land Compliance Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering through geospatial data processing within a tight timeframe.
